query:
INSERT INTO conversation_messages (conversationId, agencyId, direction, content, status, sentByUserId, createdAt)
SELECT 
  c.id AS conversationId,
  c.agencyId,
  'outbound' AS direction,
  la.content AS content,
  'sent' AS status,
  la.userId AS sentByUserId,
  la.createdAt
FROM lead_activities la
JOIN conversations c ON c.leadId = la.leadId AND c.channel = la.type
WHERE la.type IN ('sms', 'email') AND la.userId IS NOT NULL;
